content:
Hi, I'm working on a AWS services SDK experiment, and wondering how to best structure the code so proofs will be possible. It uses custom code generation to generate methods from a service schema files.

Currently, the methods are in IO/EIO which isn't particularly friendly to proving properties about. I could imagine making these polymorphic over an underlying (constrained) monad however.

I'd like to start figuring out how to prove properties about simple programs with the goal of making sure the SDK can work with Iris. One very simple example would be: suppose I have a web service that is transmitting a file. Can I prove that the file is copied correctly?

Would Iris be a good fit for this? Any recommendations on how to get started?
